info.title: Pmad.AI.DiffGuard.Cli
info.description: Git diff security, supply-chain, blast-radius, and cross-model LLM judge CLI guardrail tool.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --base
options.description: Base branch, tag, or commit-ish.

options.name: --head
options.description: Target branch, tag, or commit-ish.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path to the target Git repository root or subdirectory. [default: .]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to a repository/custom configuration JSON file.

options.name: --two-dot
options.description: Use direct tip diff (base..head) instead of merge-base diff (base...head). [default: False]

options.name: --staged
options.description: Scan staged changes in the Git index (git diff --cached). [default: False]

options.name: --working-tree
options.description: Scan uncommitted working-tree changes against HEAD. [default: False]

options.name: --commit
options.description: Scan the diff introduced by a single commit (git show <sha>).

options.name: --diff-file
options.description: Scan a pre-generated unified .diff or .patch file from disk.

options.name: --no-baseline
options.description: Skip computing repository baseline file/line counts. [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Primary output format: console, markdown (md), or sarif. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the primary format report to file instead of stdout.

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Write a Markdown report to the specified file.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Write a SARIF 2.1.0 report to the specified file.

options.name: --min-severity
options.description: Minimum severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical) that triggers exit code 2.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress/informational console messages. [default: False]

options.name: --llm-provider
options.description: LLM provider: 'none', 'ollama', or 'openai'.

options.name: --llm-model
options.description: Model identifier for the LLM security judge.

options.name: --ollama-model
options.description: Shorthand for --llm-provider ollama --llm-model <id>.

options.name: --openai-model
options.description: Shorthand for --llm-provider openai --llm-model <id>.

options.name: --llm-endpoint
options.description: Custom endpoint URL for LLM judge.

options.name: --llm-api-key
options.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

options.name: --no-llm
options.description: Explicitly disable the LLM security judge. [default: False]

options.name: --filter-deleted-lines
options.description: Compress contiguous blocks of deleted lines in LLM judge chunks. [default: False]

options.name: --max-chunk-bytes
options.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per diff chunk sent to LLM judge.

options.name: --fail-open-on-llm-error
options.description: Do not emit LLM-JUDGE-ERROR if the LLM judge request fails. [default: False]

options.name: --no-deterministic
options.description: Disable deterministic scanners and run only the LLM judge. [default: False]

options.name: --enable-prompt-injection
options.description: Enable prompt-injection detection rules (PI001-PI013). [default: False]

options.name: --no-prompt-injection
options.description: Disable prompt-injection detection rules. [default: False]

options.name: --flag-private-ips
options.description: Flag private network IP literals (NET-IP-001). [default: False]

options.name: --allow-domain
options.description: Additional trusted domain(s) appended to well-known safe domains.

options.name: --allow-ip
options.description: Additional trusted IP address(es) appended to allowed IPs.

options.name: --allow-package
options.description: Additional trusted package prefix(es) appended to safe packages.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Additional file glob pattern(s) appended to excluded files.

options.name: --test-path
options.description: Additional test file path or glob pattern(s) permitted for test tolerance.

options.name: --enable-test-tolerance
options.description: Enable safe tolerances for test files and projects (mock hosts, test packages, test fixture secrets). [default: False]

options.name: --no-test-tolerance
options.description: Disable safe tolerances for test files and projects. [default: False]

options.name: --max-changed-files
options.description: Maximum changed files threshold for blast radius.

options.name: --max-changed-lines
options.description: Maximum changed lines threshold for blast radius.

options.name: --max-codebase-pct
options.description: Maximum codebase impact percentage for blast radius.

options.name: --max-file-pct
options.description: Maximum file impact percentage for blast radius.

arguments.name: HEAD
arguments.description: Target branch, tag, or commit-ish to evaluate (e.g. 'feature/x', 'HEAD').
